description: Create a draft. A draft is not an invoice yet: it has no number, is not reported to NAV and can be deleted. Amounts and quantities are decimal strings. Take buyer data from the user or lookup_company, and ask the user for the VAT rate if you do not know it. If the answer is lost, look with search_invoices (state DRAFT) before calling this again, or there will be two drafts.

countryCode.description: Type private only: two-letter country code of a foreign private buyer (default HU).
Two-letter country code. Required for types eu_business and foreign.

email.description: Buyer e-mail; an issued invoice can be sent there.

euVatNumber.description: EU VAT number, e.g. DE123456789. Required for type eu_business.

isBusiness.description: Type foreign only: true if the buyer is a business.

taxNumber.description: Hungarian tax number, format 12345678-1-12. Required for type company.

thirdCountryTaxId.description: Tax id of a buyer outside the EU (type foreign), if it has one.

type.description: company = Hungarian company or sole trader; private = private person; eu_business = VAT-registered business in another EU country; foreign = buyer outside the EU.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: for BANK_TRANSFER the issue date plus the buyer's saved payment term, or 8 days; otherwise the issue date.

language.description: Invoice language, e.g. hu, en, de.

unitPriceGross.description: Gross unit price as a decimal string.

unitPriceNet.description: Net unit price as a decimal string. Give this or unitPriceGross, never both.

vatExemptionCase.description: TAM legal basis code, e.g. HU_VAT_ACT_85_1_B.

vatRate.description: 27%, 18% or 5% for domestic sales; AAM if the seller is VAT-exempt (alanyi adómentes); ÁKK = out of scope; TAM = exempt; 0% only for an eu_business or foreign buyer. Ask the user; never guess.

vatReason.description: Reason text for an ÁKK or TAM line.

note.description: Free text printed on the invoice.

paymentMethod.description: Default BANK_TRANSFER. COD = utánvét (cash on delivery).

performanceDate.description: Teljesítés dátuma, YYYY-MM-DD; default the issue date. For periodic services ask the user.

name: create_invoice_draft
title: Create an invoice draft
